answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each agent to stake a small deposit of value — a jade token held in escrow — before it may transact. Honest agents earn their stake back with interest, while identities caught cheating forfeit it, so creating fake agents costs real money. A public beacon service publishes the stake status of every identity, and reputation earned through verified work lets an agent bridge trust from one marketplace to another without re-proving itself from scratch.
